text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Phew, what's left to buy is—

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're Mejiro Dober-san, right? Could 
I please get your autograph!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! I'm in a huge hurry, so...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Just when I thought I was getting 
used to it. When people come on so strong, 
it really catches me off guard...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed it would take a little more time 
for Mejiro Dober to overcome her 
awkwardness around men.
